title: Federal Reserve H.4.1 Reserve-Balance Book-State Study

macro_program.name: external_market_event
macro_program.reason: The treatment is a causally published official central-bank balance-sheet state, not execution, recovery, broker-safety, entry implementation or Live observation.

research_height.transfer_path: official weekly reserve-balance change -> native signal and durable-birth supply -> US100 versus US30 lifecycle value and stop quality -> whole-portfolio book-risk research decision

central_question: When the latest causally available Federal Reserve H.4.1 release shows reserve balances expanding rather than contracting week over week, does the existing US100 book gain material and broad stressed lifecycle value and stop quality relative to the US30 book?

lenses: official archive, release-date and reserve-row integrity
normal-day native signal and durable-birth supply transmission, descriptive only
component-period-centered US100-minus-US30 stressed-R and stop-rate difference-in-differences
research_bundle.bundle_rule: The two signs are the treatment and comparator of one threshold-free state question. They are frozen, judged and closed together.

predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.method: The official H.4.1 release-date JSON and 214 official archived release pages from 2022-07-21 through 2026-08-20 were read transiently. Only the exact Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks row, release dates, CP2 SIZE_DAY/SIGNAL_DECIDED/birth timestamps and component identities were inspected. No source artifact was persisted and no CP2 final value, planned risk, stressed-R or stop reason was read.
predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.selection_use: Causal availability, novelty and density only; no treatment direction, economic magnitude, threshold or verdict was selected from portfolio outcomes.

release_schedule_page.purpose: Official Thursday 16:30 Eastern publication schedule, federal-holiday shift rule and archive authority.

official_sources_to_acquire_after_declar.target_row: Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks in table 1
persistent_outputs: one 214-row normalized release CSV containing URL, page bytes/SHA-256, exact row text/SHA-256, parsed reserve values/change and state
one acquisition receipt enumerating every URL/hash, semantic check and aggregate byte count
official_sources_to_acquire_after_declar.bounded_storage_rule: The 214 full archived HTML pages are immutable public releases and are not duplicated into Git. The batch hashes every complete response and persists exact target-row text plus full-page URL, bytes and SHA-256.

causal_availability_contract.official_schedule: H.4.1 is released each Thursday generally at 4:30 p.m. U.S. Eastern time, with publication shifted to the next business day for a federal holiday.
causal_availability_contract.same_day_exclusion: All frozen native decisions occur before normal publication. A release labels only a portfolio server date strictly later than its official release date.
causal_availability_contract.holiday_release: A holiday-shifted release uses its exact archive date and likewise becomes usable only on a strictly later server date.
causal_availability_contract.state_lookup: For each event, select the latest normalized H.4.1 release date strictly less than the event server date.
causal_availability_contract.revision_protection: State values come from each dated archived release page, not a current DDP or FRED historical series.
causal_availability_contract.timezone_boundary: Only the strict next-server-date rule is used; no intraday conversion, DST window or same-day event outcome is allowed.

frozen_reserve_state.source_field: Table 1, Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks, Averages of daily figures, Change from week ended
frozen_reserve_state.RESERVE_EXPAND: Signed week-over-week change strictly greater than zero.
frozen_reserve_state.RESERVE_CONTRACT: Signed week-over-week change strictly less than zero.
frozen_reserve_state.ZERO: An exact zero is not a third state; it violates the frozen feasibility anchor and makes acquisition invalid.
no_transform: no magnitude threshold, percentile, z-score or quantile
no total-assets, TGA, reverse-repo or component decomposition

frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.ordering: Within each period concatenate pinned files and preserve stable source-file/source-row order for equal server timestamps.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.normal_day: Each unique SIZE_DAY server date is one normal portfolio day.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED row is one observed native passed opportunity.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.birth: OPEN for RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure and Return; PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.final: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE paired by strict per-component alternation. Stressed P/L is value_b; planned_risk and DEAL_REASON are parsed from detail.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.stressed_r: value_b divided by positive planned_risk at final close.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.stop: One for DEAL_REASON_SL and zero for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.centering: Subtract the all-state component-period mean stressed_r and stop rate from each lifecycle before state/book aggregation.
frozen_event_and_lifecycle_reconstructio.supply_context: Report per-day signal and birth counts plus fewer-than-three-signal-day rate by state. Supply is descriptive and cannot select treatment.

fixed_primary_metrics.supply_effect: RESERVE_EXPAND minus RESERVE_CONTRACT signals/day, births/day and fewer-than-three-signal-day rate.
fixed_primary_metrics.book_r_effect: For each book, mean centered stressed_r in RESERVE_EXPAND minus RESERVE_CONTRACT.
fixed_primary_metrics.book_stop_effect: For each book, mean centered stop in RESERVE_EXPAND minus RESERVE_CONTRACT.
fixed_primary_metrics.relative_stop_did: US100 book_stop_effect minus US30 book_stop_effect; negative favors US100 under expansion.
fixed_primary_metrics.period_metrics: Repeat both differences-in-differences inside each frozen period.
fixed_primary_metrics.component_metrics: Report each component's expand-minus-contract centered R and stop effect without subgroup selection.
fixed_primary_metrics.concentration: Maximum period and component contribution shares of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator.

requirements: All declared project and acquired official byte/hash pins pass.
The official index contains exactly 214 unique dates from 2022-07-21 through 2026-08-20.
Every archive URL displays a Release Date matching its URL and exactly one target reserve row.
Each row parses finite current-week average, week change, year change and Wednesday level; exact row text and complete response are pinned.
The archive reproduces exactly 108 expansion, 106 contraction and zero exact-zero releases.
Lifecycle reconstruction yields exactly 2,233 pairs, 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals, matching prior component, period, book, stressed-net and stop anchors within 1e-9.
Exactly 1,051 SIZE_DAY dates and 2,429 SIGNAL_DECIDED rows reconstruct without duplicate or unmatched event.
Every day, signal and lifecycle maps to exactly one causally prior release state.
Each state has at least 40 days per period, each period-book-state cell at least 40 lifecycles and each pooled component-state cell at least 40 lifecycles.

reserve_expansion_us100_relative_value: US100 R is positive and stop effect negative; US30 R is negative and stop effect positive.
Both relative directions hold in at least three of four periods.
Both US100 components align; at least three of four US30 components align oppositely.
No period contributes over 60 percent and no component over 45 percent of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator.
reserve_contraction_us30_relative_value: US100 R is negative and stop effect positive; US30 R is positive and stop effect negative.
Both relative directions hold in at least three of four periods.
Both US100 components align; at least three of four US30 components align oppositely.
No period contributes over 60 percent and no component over 45 percent of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator.

requirements: Absolute pooled relative_r_did is less than 0.05R.
Absolute pooled relative_stop_did is less than 0.025.
Neither direction holds concordantly in more than two periods.
Neither US100 pair nor three of four US30 components jointly support one complete direction.

fixed_verdict_rules.reserve_expansion_us100: PASS_RESERVE_EXPANSION_US100_RELATIVE_BOOK_VALUE_RETAIN_ONE_BOOK_RISK_QUESTION when every integrity and expansion-US100 gate passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.reserve_contraction_us30: PASS_RESERVE_CONTRACTION_US30_RELATIVE_BOOK_VALUE_RETAIN_ONE_BOOK_RISK_QUESTION when every integrity and contraction-US30 gate passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_FEDERAL_RESERVE_BALANCE_SHEET_BOOK_FIELD when integrity and the complete strong-null rule pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_FEDERAL_RESERVE_RESERVE_BALANCE_BOOK_STATE_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes and no preceding verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_H41_RELEASE_OR_BOOK_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any source, row, event, lifecycle, coverage or density integrity requirement fails.

decision_translation.directional_pass: Preserve current behavior and retain one non-automatic future whole-portfolio real-tick bounded book-risk question. This unit authorizes no implementation.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Preserve unconditional book treatment, retain no H.4.1 seed and rotate away.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away without same-family data, parser, lag, field or subgroup rescue after budget exhaustion.
